name: CFAパターン検出
description: Searches for Bayer カラーフィルタアレイ demosaicing アーティファクト left by real camera sensors. This fingerprint is a strong indicator of real photography and is absent in AI images.
algorithm: カラーフィルタアレイ (Bayer CFA) Demosaicing Trace Detection
mechanism: 検出します periodic 相関 パターン from Bayer CFA demosaicing in real cameras. These traces are absent in AI生成の images.
parameters: Analysis: 2D auto相関 of green channel, Expected パターン: 2x2 periodic
accuracy: 高 - 80-92% for images from known camera sensors
source: Popescu and Farid (2005), ACM Workshop on Multimedia and Security
useCase: Verifying authentic camera origin through CFA demosaicing アーティファクト

references.title: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005). Exposing Digital Forgeries in Color Filter Array Interpolated Images. IEEE TSP.
Dirik, A.E. & Memon, N. (2009). Image tamper detection based on demosaicing artifacts. IEEE ICIP.

strengths:
• Strong indicator of real camera origin
• Based on physical sensor hardware
• Difficult for AI to simulate CFA パターン
• Very low 誤検出 rate on camera images
limitations:
• Only 検出する presence/absence of CFA パターン
• Some cameras apply heavy demosaicing that masks パターン

• Cannot identify specific camera model
